newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone Pancho still threatens S.Indian Ocean ship.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone Pancho still threatens S.Indian Ocean ship.

text.p: Tropical Cyclone Pancho, with 135 mph winds, is over open water in the southern Indian Ocean near 14s/89e and remains a major threat to shipping, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
Pancho is moving southwest at four mph.
It is expected to begin a slow weakening trend, but will remain quite strong and a danger to shipping. It poses no threat to major land areas, WSC said.
